::: {#exr-lstm-pixels}

#### An LSTM reading pixels

`make_reader(nn.LSTM, 1)` reads the pixels with an [LSTM](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/cnn-rnn.html#def-lstm) layer instead,
with no clipping.
Trained for 20 [epochs](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-epoch),
does it classify more test digits correctly than the pixel reader of @sol-clipped?

:::
